ns2:course.label: Engineering Design Principles
ns2:course.description: (T A M 292) Examples of mechanical design problems that occur in engineering practice and the procedures and issues involved in solving them; technical aspects and societal ramifications of the design process; intellectual property, ethics, and contemporary issues; probability and statistics; computational mechanics; case studies; student discussion of design-related issues at different levels; design project reports and presentations; student teams Prerequisite: Junior standing in engineering.
